# Webamp 2.3.1

This folder contains the pinned classic-script lazy bundle used by the shared footer player and the corresponding MIT license.

- Project: https://github.com/captbaritone/webamp
- Documentation: https://docs.webamp.org/
- Installed version: 2.3.1
- Bundle: `webamp-2.3.1.lazy.min.js`

The lazy bundle loads the local music-metadata adapter to read titles, artists, and albums directly from MP3 tags. Durations come from the media files. The site does not expose custom skin loading. The dependency is served locally so the static website does not rely on a third-party CDN at runtime.
